## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given [initial state], when [action], then [expected result].
- [ ] Given empty or whitespace input, when submitted, then no new chat pair is added.
- [ ] Given a prompt that matches no configured phrase, when submitted, then the documented fallback is shown.
- [ ] Given the conversation is cleared, then previous in-memory messages are removed.
- [ ] Keyboard and assistive technology behavior is specified.
- [ ] Narrow viewport and zoom behavior are specified where relevant.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Implementation and acceptance criteria agree.
- [ ] Automated regression tests are added or updated.
- [ ] Manual browser checks are identified and recorded.
- [ ] Accessibility is reviewed for changed interaction.
- [ ] Docs, response catalog, diagrams, and examples are updated.
- [ ] No unsupported capability or metric is claimed.
